label: Truth-preserving decoded content RECORD_TRANSPORT_2
term: record transport preserving truth in admitted histories
definition: TruthTransport S K allowed D means: at each admitted history i, if a content c in the named domain D is true under the existing Semantics S, then decoding receipt of its specified code is also true at that SAME i. It does not assert c is true, identify the two contents, or assert any actual record came from that code. SourceGuarantee uses this weaker sense together with independently supplied source truth, assertoric scope, realization and provenance.
note: RECORD_TRANSPORT_2 concerns truth preservation rather than exact identity or fallible epistemic warrant. It remains an OPEN channel condition. The retagging model witnesses its compatibility with failure of RECORD_TRANSPORT_1 on nonempty domains and nonconstant observations; no translation practice is thereby certified.
